body:
C-05 DEFENSE — the gates are orthogonal and both are in the applicant text. Exact PDF: p6 says partial STT may prepare search but cannot publish and only verified material moves public; p7 defines evidence verdicts (SUPPORTED public-eligible; UNCERTAIN presenter-only; CONFLICTING no auto-publication; UNSUPPORTED discard/no-evidence); p8 says audience display receives only SUPPORTED and adds STALE/SUPERSEDED; p9 repeats SUPPORTED-only public routing; p10 adds presenter/team approval before the auxiliary screen; p11's <=5 s target is 'recommend up to 3,' not 'publish.' Thus 5 s can end at Presenter Console recommendation without violating approval.

Minimal machine = three small orthogonal fields, not one state explosion:
`verdict = PENDING|SUPPORTED|UNCERTAIN|CONFLICTING|UNSUPPORTED`
`publication = HIDDEN|PENDING_APPROVAL|PUBLISHED|REJECTED`
`freshness = CURRENT|STALE|SUPERSEDED`
Guards: candidate starts PENDING/HIDDEN/CURRENT; only SUPPORTED+CURRENT -> PENDING_APPROVAL; one hotkey/tap -> PUBLISHED; any slide change or supersession atomically retracts; all non-SUPPORTED stay HIDDEN (UNCERTAIN may show privately). ACL is checked before retrieval and again before publication, downstream—not by LLM.

Latency/cognitive-load answer: verification and approval overlap UX-wise—pre-render max 3 ranked cards in Presenter Console, single action approves, default focus on #1, no modal. Do NOT force an approval decision; ignoring expires the card. The audience path never waits while the presenter continues speaking.

Safe auto-publish? Under the current applicant promise: NO, because p10 explicitly requires presenter/team approval. A later low-risk, external-only allowlisted policy could be tested, but cannot be called safe without measured false-support/conflict/retraction rates; internal RAG should never auto-publish because even a relevant ACL-authorized excerpt can disclose sensitive content to the audience. OWASP LLM06 recommends human approval for high-impact actions and downstream authorization rather than relying on the LLM: https://genai.owasp.org/llmrisk/llm062025-excessive-agency/ . This supports the publication gate and ACL recheck, while applicant pages are the decisive product requirement.
summary: C-05 defended with minimal dual-gate state machine
